grade_reason: No statement by Reschenthaler about AI, AI risk or AI policy was found in eight web searches or in the official press release list.
notes: All 8 web searches ran (none refused). None of the results mentioned Reschenthaler; the site: search returned no pages from reschenthaler.house.gov. Older press releases, hearing transcripts and floor speeches were not checked page by page. Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act (H.R. 10538, Casar, September 2026): search results describe its roughly 9 to 10 House cosponsors as Democrats and none names Reschenthaler; this was not confirmed against the congress.gov cosponsor list, so absence of co-sponsorship is likely but not verified. No House letter on AI risk signed by him was found (the multi-signer August and September 2026 letters were not searched, per instructions).
